faqs.a: JoharYatra is a smart digital platform for eco and cultural tourism in Jharkhand. It helps you plan trips, explore destinations, experience tribal culture, and support local communities — all in one place.
Yes! JoharYatra is a lightweight, zero-cost platform. You can plan trips, explore the map, browse the culture hub, and use the assistant without any fees.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit Jharkhand?
faqs.a: October to March is ideal — pleasant weather, clear skies, and festival season (Sarhul in spring, Tusu in winter). Monsoon (July–September) is beautiful for waterfalls but roads can be challenging.

faqs.q: How does the Smart Trip Planner work?
faqs.a: Choose your interests, trip duration, and budget. Our rule-based engine matches your preferences with curated destinations and generates a personalized day-by-day itinerary.

faqs.q: Are the guides and homestays verified?
faqs.a: Yes. Verified partners carry a digital certificate badge. You can check verification status on every guide and homestay listing before booking.

Your Eco Score measures how sustainably you travel — choosing local homestays, buying from artisans, and visiting eco-friendly destinations all increase your score. Earn badges as you explore responsibly!

faqs.q: Can I use JoharYatra in Hindi?
faqs.a: The platform supports both English and Hindi. During onboarding, you can choose your preferred language for navigation and content.

Ranchi has the nearest airport (Birsa Munda Airport) with daily flights from Delhi, Kolkata, and Mumbai. Major rail hubs include Ranchi, Dhanbad, and Tatanagar. Road connectivity is excellent via NH-31, NH-33, and NH-2.
